detail.body:
## Motivation

Add native SGLang serving support for [Diffuspace/Clover-35B-A3B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/Diffuspace/Clover-35B-A3B-Preview), using a shared model for parallel draft generation and autoregressive verification.

Clover generates a block of draft tokens through its preview pathway, verifies the proposals through the autoregressive pathway, and commits the accepted prefix for the next decoding step.

## Modifications

- Register `CLOVER` as a speculative-decoding algorithm and add `CloverMoeModelLM` support.
- Implement Clover draft generation, verification, and accept-token bookkeeping.
- Manage KV cache and recurrent state across preview and verification passes.
- Integrate preview attention through `CloverPreviewFlashInferBackend` and the Clover linear-attention backend.
- Support CUDA-graph execution for Clover decoding.
- Add `--speculative-clover-accept-rule {threshold,exact}`: threshold remains the default; exact matches drafts against the penalty-adjusted verify argmax and stops at the first mismatch. 
- Add configurable threshold parameters and Clover sampling penalties.
- Validate model compatibility, draft width, launch configuration, and unsupported request options.
- Document Clover launch configuration, acceptance semantics, sampling defaults, and platform limitations in the speculative-decoding guide.

## Changes to shared SGLang infrastructure

- Add configuration and dispatch hooks for the Clover model and worker.
- Integrate Clover request validation and decoding results with the scheduler.
- Keep Clover preview attention adaptation in its dedicated backend subclass.

## Validation

Hardware: NVIDIA H200 (1 GPU for DP=1 and 4 GPUs for DP=4). EvalScope, one run per question, thinking enabled, temperature=0, top_p=1, presence_penalty=0.9, repetition_penalty=1.05, frequency_penalty=0. 

| Dataset | Acceptance rule | Block size | DP | Concurrency per rank | Max output tokens | Accuracy | Aggregate output tok/s | Per-request output tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MATH500 | Threshold (ratio=1.0, delta=0.6) | 16 | 1 | 1 | 32768 | 96.6% (483/500) | 450.59 | 453.59 |
| MATH500 | Threshold (ratio=1.0, delta=0.6) | 16 | 4 | 8 | 32768 | 95.2% (476/500) | 4268.73 | 192.13 |




Additional validation:
- CPU configuration/model/penalty/metadata regression: 42 tests, 88 subtests passed.
- GPU kernel/graph regression: 19 tests and 2 acceptance-rule subtests passed, including independent convolution/GDN numerical checks and CUDA-graph capture/replay with refreshed candidates.
- Replica DP=2: 8/8 math smoke checks; DP=4: the full MATH500 evaluation above. TP=2 with EP=2: 4/4 math smoke checks, using Triton MoE and no all-to-all backend.
- PP remains restricted to 1; PP=2 is rejected. Attention DP/CP, DCP, and unsupported EP backends remain gated.
- Sampling-penalty and request-validation checks are covered by unit tests; prefix-cache, stop/abort, and mixed-length batch checks are covered by the manual Clover server regression script.
- Pre-commit passed for all changed files, including isort, Ruff, Ruff format, codespell, and registered-test validation.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

It accepts a proposal when its target probability is at least `min(ratio, delta * exp(-entropy))` and greater than zero. Configure the ceiling and entropy-scaled factor with `--speculative-clover-accept-ratio` (default `1.0`) and `--speculative-clover-accept-delta` (default `0.6`). +- `exact` accepts only proposals matching the penalty-adjusted target verify argmax, stopping at the first mismatch. + + +Neither rule is distribution-preserving stochastic speculative sampling. Exact greedy AR equivalence additionally requires identical target-logit processing. + + +Clover sets preferred sampling defaults of `presence_penalty=0.9` and `repetition_penalty=1.05`. It also enables `dllm_length_penalty=10` and `dllm_think_end_bias=10` through request `custom_params`. To disable all four, set `presence_penalty=0`, `repetition_penalty=1.0`, and request `custom_params` of `{"dllm_length_penalty": 0, "dllm_think_end_bias": 0}`. Explicit server or request preferences take precedence over these defaults. + +### Requirements and limitations + +- Requires CUDA and BF16. Current end-to-end validation uses NVIDIA H200 GPUs. +- Uses FlashInfer for full attention and Triton or FlashInfer for linear attention. +- Requires pipeline parallel size 1. Attention DP/CP, DCP, and all-to-all MoE backends are gated; EP is supported only with the Triton MoE runner. +- Does not support quantized checkpoints, LoRA, `torch.compile`, adaptive speculation, a separate dLLM algorithm, disaggregation, HiCache, or watermarking. +- Does not support `min_p`, structured-output constraints, logit bias, logprobs, returned hidden states or routed experts, custom logit processors, or input embedding overrides. +- Disables the overlap scheduler and mixed chunked prefill, and runs one speculative step with top-k 1. Enable it with `--speculative-algorithm STANDALONE` and provide a draft model via `--speculative-draft-model-path`.

+"""Triton kernel for GDN local memory in diffusion."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+def _check_bd_gdn_softmax_scalars(
+    logit_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+    history_bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    num_value_heads: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    if logit_scale is None or history_bias is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover requires per-head bd_softmax_logit_scale and "
+            "bd_softmax_history_bias tensors"
+        )
+    if (
+        logit_scale.numel() != num_value_heads
+        or history_bias.numel() != num_value_heads
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN softmax scalars must have one entry per local value head: "
+            f"expected {num_value_heads}, got {logit_scale.numel()} and "
+            f"{history_bias.numel()}"
+        )
+    # The kernel converts these scalars to FP32 on load, so BF16 views pass unconverted.
+    return logit_scale.reshape(-1), history_bias.reshape(-1)
+
+
+def _check_bd_gdn_softmax_blocksize_scalars(
+    history_c: torch.Tensor | None,
+    reference_block_size: float,
+    num_value_heads: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if history_c is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN style 'softmax_blocksize' requires per-head bd_softmax_history_c"
+        )
+    if history_c.numel() != num_value_heads:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN block-size history scalar must have one entry per local "
+            f"value head: expected {num_value_heads}, got {history_c.numel()}"
+        )
+    if not reference_block_size > 0.0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN softmax reference block size must be positive, got "
+            f"{reference_block_size!r}"
+        )
+    return history_c.reshape(-1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_local_memory_kernel(
+    query_ptr,
+    key_ptr,
+    value_ptr,
+    g_ptr,
+    clean_state_ptr,
+    cache_indices_ptr,
+    active_valid_ptr,
+    softmax_logit_scale_ptr,
+    softmax_history_bias_ptr,
+    softmax_history_c_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    query_stride_t,
+    query_stride_h,
+    query_stride_k,
+    key_stride_t,
+    key_stride_h,
+    key_stride_k,
+    value_stride_t,
+    value_stride_h,
+    value_stride_v,
+    g_stride_t,
+    g_stride_h,
+    state_stride_slot,
+    state_stride_h,
+    state_stride_v,
+    state_stride_k,
+    output_stride_t,
+    output_stride_h,
+    output_stride_v,
+    scale,
+    softmax_reference_block_size,
+    NUM_Q_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_K_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_V_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    KEY_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    VALUE_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_Q: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_QUERY_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Compute the read-only BD-GDN preview output for one fixed-size block.
+
+    Block-local softmax includes the gate-decayed clean readout as one
+    history bucket. Its logit is history_bias plus
+    history_c * log(valid_block_size / reference_block_size).
+
+    One program handles one request, one value head, and one value-dimension
+    tile. Persistent state is read directly in SGLang's [slot, H, V, K]
+    layout and is never written.
+    """
+    value_tile = tl.program_id(0)
+    query_program = tl.program_id(1)
+    request_idx = query_program // NUM_QUERY_TILES
+    query_tile = query_program % NUM_QUERY_TILES
+    value_head = tl.program_id(2)
+
+    token_offsets = query_tile * BLOCK_Q + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_Q)
+    local_key_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_T)
+    key_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    value_offsets = value_tile * BLOCK_V + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+    token_mask = token_offsets < BLOCK_SIZE
+    local_key_mask = local_key_offsets < BLOCK_SIZE
+    key_mask = key_offsets < KEY_DIM
+    value_mask = value_offsets < VALUE_DIM
+    token_indices = request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + token_offsets
+
+    cache_index = tl.load(cache_indices_ptr + request_idx)
+    request_active = cache_index >= 0
+    safe_cache_index = tl.maximum(cache_index, 0)
+    active = (
+        tl.load(active_valid_ptr + token_indices, mask=token_mask, other=0) != 0
+    ) & request_active
+
+    query_head = value_head // (NUM_V_HEADS // NUM_Q_HEADS)
+    key_head = value_head // (NUM_V_HEADS // NUM_K_HEADS)
+
+    query_offsets = (
+        token_indices[:, None] * query_stride_t
+        + query_head * query_stride_h
+        + key_offsets[None, :] * query_stride_k
+    )
+    key_offsets_transposed = (
+        (request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + local_key_offsets)[None, :] * key_stride_t
+        + key_head * key_stride_h
+        + key_offsets[:, None] * key_stride_k
+    )
+    value_matrix_offsets = (
+        (request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + local_key_offsets)[:, None] * value_stride_t
+        + value_head * value_stride_h
+        + value_offsets[None, :] * value_stride_v
+    )
+
+    query = tl.load(
+        query_ptr + query_offsets,
+        mask=token_mask[:, None] & key_mask[None, :] & request_active,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    key_transposed = tl.load(
+        key_ptr + key_offsets_transposed,
+        mask=key_mask[:, None] & local_key_mask[None, :] & request_active,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    values = tl.load(
+        value_ptr + value_matrix_offsets,
+        mask=local_key_mask[:, None] & value_mask[None, :] & request_active,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+
+    # The 1e-6 epsilon matches the GDN L2 normalization.
+    query_f32 = query.to(tl.float32)
+    query_norm = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(query_f32 * query_f32, axis=1) + 1.0e-6)
+    query = (query_f32 * query_norm[:, None]).to(query.dtype)
+    key_f32 = key_transposed.to(tl.float32)
+    key_norm = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(key_f32 * key_f32, axis=0) + 1.0e-6)
+    key_transposed = (key_f32 * key_norm[None, :]).to(key_transposed.dtype)
+
+    state_offsets = (
+        safe_cache_index * state_stride_slot
+        + value_head * state_stride_h
+        + value_offsets[None, :] * state_stride_v
+        + key_offsets[:, None] * state_stride_k
+    )
+    clean_state = tl.load(
+        clean_state_ptr + state_offsets,
+        mask=key_mask[:, None] & value_mask[None, :] & request_active,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+
+    scalar_offsets = token_indices * g_stride_t + value_head * g_stride_h
+    g = tl.load(g_ptr + scalar_offsets, mask=token_mask & request_active, other=0.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+    local_active = (
+        tl.load(
+            active_valid_ptr + request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + local_key_offsets,
+            mask=local_key_mask,
+            other=0,
+        )
+        != 0
+    ) & request_active
+
+    history = tl.dot(query, clean_state.to(query.dtype))
+    scores = tl.dot(query, key_transposed)
+    logit_scale = tl.load(softmax_logit_scale_ptr + value_head).to(tl.float32)
+    history_bias = tl.load(softmax_history_bias_ptr + value_head).to(tl.float32)
+    history_c = tl.load(softmax_history_c_ptr + value_head).to(tl.float32)
+    valid_block_size = tl.maximum(tl.sum(local_active, axis=0), 1.0)
+    history_bias += history_c * tl.log(valid_block_size / softmax_reference_block_size)
+    logits = scores * logit_scale
+    logits = tl.where(local_active[None, :], logits, float("-inf"))
+    row_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(logits, axis=1), history_bias)
+    exp_local = tl.exp(logits - row_max[:, None])
+    exp_history = tl.exp(history_bias - row_max)
+    denominator = tl.sum(exp_local, axis=1) + exp_history
+    local_weights = exp_local / denominator[:, None]
+    history_weight = exp_history / denominator
+    local = tl.dot(local_weights.to(values.dtype), values)
+    output = history * (scale * tl.exp(g) * history_weight)[:, None] + local
+    output = tl.where(active[:, None], output, 0.0)
+
+    output_offsets = (
+        token_indices[:, None] * output_stride_t
+        + value_head * output_stride_h
+        + value_offsets[None, :] * output_stride_v
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        output_ptr + output_offsets,
+        output,
+        mask=token_mask[:, None] & value_mask[None, :],
+    )
+
+
+def supports_clover_local_memory_triton(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    value: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    block_size: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the specialized production kernel supports this shape."""
+    return (
+        query.is_cuda
+        and query.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+        and key.dtype == query.dtype
+        and value.dtype == query.dtype
+        and query.ndim == key.ndim == value.ndim == 4
+        and query.shape[0] == key.shape[0] == value.shape[0] == 1
+        and block_size in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)
+        and query.shape[-1] == key.shape[-1] == 128
+        and value.shape[-1] == 128
+        and value.shape[2] % query.shape[2] == 0
+        and value.shape[2] % key.shape[2] == 0
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(query.device)[0] in (9, 10)
+    )
+
+
+def clover_local_memory_triton(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    value: torch.Tensor,
+    g: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    clean_ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    active_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: float,
+    softmax_logit_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    softmax_history_bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    softmax_history_c: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    softmax_reference_block_size: float = 32.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run the non-mutating fixed-block BD-GDN preview kernel.
+
+    Uses Clover's softmax_blocksize rule with learned per-head history scalars.
+    """
+    batch_size = cache_indices.numel()
+    if batch_size <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("BD-GDN Triton preview requires a non-empty batch")
+    num_tokens = query.shape[1]
+    if num_tokens % batch_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"BD-GDN token count {num_tokens} is not divisible by batch {batch_size}"
+        )
+    block_size = num_tokens // batch_size
+    if not supports_clover_local_memory_triton(
+        query, key, value, block_size=block_size
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "BD-GDN Triton preview supports CUDA BF16/FP16, block_size in "
+            "{1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, "
+            "and key/value dimensions 128"
+        )
+    if active_valid_mask.numel() != num_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(f"{active_valid_mask.numel()=} does not match {num_tokens=}")
+
+    num_q_heads = query.shape[2]
+    num_k_heads = key.shape[2]
+    num_v_heads = value.shape[2]
+    key_dim = query.shape[-1]
+    value_dim = value.shape[-1]
+    if clean_ssm_states.ndim != 4 or clean_ssm_states.shape[1:] != (
+        num_v_heads,
+        value_dim,
+        key_dim,
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN clean state must use SGLang [slot, H, V, K] layout, got "
+            f"{tuple(clean_ssm_states.shape)}"
+        )
+    if clean_ssm_states.device != value.device:
+        raise ValueError("BD-GDN clean state and preview tensors must share a device")
+    logit_scale, history_bias = _check_bd_gdn_softmax_scalars(
+        softmax_logit_scale, softmax_history_bias, num_v_heads
+    )
+    if logit_scale.device != value.device or history_bias.device != value.device:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN softmax scalars and preview tensors must share a device"
+        )
+    logit_scale = logit_scale.contiguous()
+    history_bias = history_bias.contiguous()
+    history_c = _check_bd_gdn_softmax_blocksize_scalars(
+        softmax_history_c,
+        softmax_reference_block_size,
+        num_v_heads,
+    )
+    if history_c.device != value.device:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN block-size history scalar and preview tensors must share a device"
+        )
+    history_c = history_c.contiguous()
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (1, num_tokens, num_v_heads, value_dim),
+        dtype=value.dtype,
+        device=value.device,
+    )
+
+    # tl.dot needs K of at least 16, and token_mask zeroes the padded rows.

+"""Read-only forward Triton convolution for diffusion blocks in Clover."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _bd_gdn_preview_conv_kernel(
+    input_ptr,
+    clean_state_ptr,
+    cache_indices_ptr,
+    weight_ptr,
+    bias_ptr,
+    right_weight_ptr,
+    active_valid_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    input_stride_t,
+    input_stride_c,
+    state_stride_slot,
+    state_stride_c,
+    state_stride_w,
+    weight_stride_c,
+    weight_stride_w,
+    right_weight_stride_c,
+    right_weight_stride_w,
+    output_stride_t,
+    output_stride_c,
+    NUM_CHANNELS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+    INDEPENDENT_SYMMETRIC: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_TOKEN_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_C: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    channel_offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_C + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_C)
+    token_program = tl.program_id(1)
+    request_idx = token_program // NUM_TOKEN_TILES
+    token_tile = token_program % NUM_TOKEN_TILES
+    token_offsets = token_tile * BLOCK_T + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_T)
+    channel_mask = channel_offsets < NUM_CHANNELS
+    token_mask = token_offsets < BLOCK_SIZE
+    token_indices = request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + token_offsets
+
+    cache_index = tl.load(cache_indices_ptr + request_idx)
+    request_active = cache_index >= 0
+    safe_cache_index = tl.maximum(cache_index, 0)
+    output_active = (
+        tl.load(active_valid_ptr + token_indices, mask=token_mask, other=0) != 0
+    ) & request_active
+
+    if HAS_BIAS:
+        bias = tl.load(bias_ptr + channel_offsets, mask=channel_mask, other=0.0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+    else:
+        bias = tl.zeros((BLOCK_C,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    accumulator = tl.broadcast_to(bias[None, :], (BLOCK_T, BLOCK_C))
+
+    for tap in tl.static_range(WIDTH):
+        relative_source = token_offsets + tap - (WIDTH - 1)
+        from_current = relative_source >= 0
+        current_token = request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.maximum(relative_source, 0)
+        current_valid = (
+            tl.load(
+                active_valid_ptr + current_token,
+                mask=token_mask & from_current,
+                other=0,
+            )
+            != 0
+        ) & request_active
+        current_value = tl.load(
+            input_ptr
+            + current_token[:, None] * input_stride_t
+            + channel_offsets[None, :] * input_stride_c,
+            mask=(token_mask & from_current & current_valid)[:, None]
+            & channel_mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+
+        history_offset = relative_source + (WIDTH - 1)
+        history_value = tl.load(
+            clean_state_ptr
+            + safe_cache_index * state_stride_slot
+            + channel_offsets[None, :] * state_stride_c
+            + tl.maximum(history_offset, 0)[:, None] * state_stride_w,
+            mask=(token_mask & ~from_current & request_active)[:, None]
+            & channel_mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        source_value = tl.where(from_current[:, None], current_value, history_value)
+        weight = tl.load(
+            weight_ptr + channel_offsets * weight_stride_c + tap * weight_stride_w,
+            mask=channel_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        accumulator += source_value * weight[None, :]
+
+    if INDEPENDENT_SYMMETRIC:
+        right_accumulator = tl.zeros((BLOCK_T, BLOCK_C), dtype=tl.float32)
+        for tap in tl.static_range(WIDTH - 1):
+            distance = WIDTH - 1 - tap
+            right_offset = token_offsets + distance
+            right_token = request_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + right_offset
+            right_valid = (
+                tl.load(
+                    active_valid_ptr + right_token,
+                    mask=token_mask & (right_offset < BLOCK_SIZE),
+                    other=0,
+                )
+                != 0
+            ) & request_active
+            right_value = tl.load(
+                input_ptr
+                + right_token[:, None] * input_stride_t
+                + channel_offsets[None, :] * input_stride_c,
+                mask=(token_mask & (right_offset < BLOCK_SIZE) & right_valid)[:, None]
+                & channel_mask[None, :],
+                other=0.0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            weight = tl.load(
+                right_weight_ptr
+                + channel_offsets * right_weight_stride_c
+                + (distance - 1) * right_weight_stride_w,
+                mask=channel_mask,
+                other=0.0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            right_accumulator += right_value * weight[None, :]
+        accumulator += right_accumulator
+
+    output = accumulator * tl.sigmoid(accumulator)
+    output = tl.where(output_active[:, None], output, 0.0)
+    tl.store(
+        output_ptr
+        + token_indices[:, None] * output_stride_t
+        + channel_offsets[None, :] * output_stride_c,
+        output,
+        mask=token_mask[:, None] & channel_mask[None, :],
+    )
+
+
+def supports_clover_local_memory_conv(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    conv_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int,
+    activation: str,
+) -> bool:
+    channels = mixed_qkv.shape[-1] if mixed_qkv.ndim == 2 else 0
+    width = conv_weights.numel() // channels if channels else 0
+    return (
+        mixed_qkv.is_cuda
+        and mixed_qkv.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+        and mixed_qkv.ndim == 2
+        and block_size in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32)
+        and width == 4
+        and activation in ("silu", "swish")
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(mixed_qkv.device)[0] in (9, 10)
+    )
+
+
+def clover_local_memory_conv(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    clean_conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    activation: str,
+    block_size: int,
+    active_valid_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_mode: str = "causal",
+    conv_right_weight: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Convolve a noisy block without copying or updating clean history."""
+    num_tokens, channels = mixed_qkv.shape
+    batch_size = cache_indices.numel()
+    if num_tokens != batch_size * block_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN preview requires one fixed block per request: "
+            f"{num_tokens=} != {batch_size=} * {block_size=}"
+        )
+    if not supports_clover_local_memory_conv(
+        mixed_qkv,
+        conv_weights=conv_weights,
+        block_size=block_size,
+        activation=activation,
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "BD-GDN preview conv Triton supports CUDA BF16/FP16, block_size in "
+            "{1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, "
+            "width=4, and SiLU"
+        )
+    width = conv_weights.numel() // channels
+    if clean_conv_states.ndim != 3 or clean_conv_states.shape[1:] != (
+        channels,
+        width - 1,
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BD-GDN clean conv state must use [slot,C,W-1] layout, got "
+            f"{tuple(clean_conv_states.shape)}"
+        )
+    if active_valid_mask.numel() != num_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(f"{active_valid_mask.numel()=} does not match {num_tokens=}")
+    independent_symmetric = conv_mode == "independent_symmetric"
+    if conv_mode not in ("causal", "independent_symmetric"):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"BD-GDN preview convolution does not support conv_mode={conv_mode!r}"
+        )
+    weights = conv_weights.reshape(channels, width)
+    expected_right_shape = (channels, 1, width - 1)
+    if independent_symmetric and (
+        conv_right_weight is None
+        or tuple(conv_right_weight.shape) != expected_right_shape
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "independent_symmetric BD-GDN convolution requires right weight "
+            f"shape {expected_right_shape}, got "
+            f"{None if conv_right_weight is None else tuple(conv_right_weight.shape)}"
+        )
+    right_weights = (
+        conv_right_weight.reshape(channels, width - 1)
+        if conv_right_weight is not None
+        else weights
+    )
+    output = torch.empty_like(mixed_qkv)
+    block_t = triton.next_power_of_2(block_size)
+    num_token_tiles = triton.cdiv(block_size, block_t)
+    # 64-channel tiles measured faster for the batch 1, block 32 preview on Blackwell.
+    block_c = 64 if batch_size == 1 and block_size == 32 else 128
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(channels, block_c), batch_size * num_token_tiles)
+    _bd_gdn_preview_conv_kernel[grid](
+        mixed_qkv,
+        clean_conv_states,
+        cache_indices,
+        weights,
+        bias if bias is not None else mixed_qkv,
+        right_weights,
+        active_valid_mask,
+        output,
+        mixed_qkv.stride(0),
+        mixed_qkv.stride(1),
+        clean_conv_states.stride(0),
+        clean_conv_states.stride(1),
+        clean_conv_states.stride(2),
+        weights.stride(0),
+        weights.stride(1),
+        right_weights.stride(0),
+        right_weights.stride(1),
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        NUM_CHANNELS=channels,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=block_size,
+        WIDTH=width,
+        HAS_BIAS=bias is not None,
+        INDEPENDENT_SYMMETRIC=independent_symmetric,
+        BLOCK_T=block_t,
+        NUM_TOKEN_TILES=num_token_tiles,
+        BLOCK_C=block_c,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=2,
+    )
+    return output

+"""Clover causal verify convolution with non-mutating state snapshots."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import is_arch_support_pdl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_parallel_causal_conv(
+    X,
+    W,
+    BIAS,
+    STATE,
+    SLOTS,
+    INTER,
+    ISLOTS,
+    O,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    T: tl.constexpr,
+    XS: tl.constexpr,
+    XD: tl.constexpr,
+    XT: tl.constexpr,
+    WD: tl.constexpr,
+    WW: tl.constexpr,
+    SS: tl.constexpr,
+    SD: tl.constexpr,
+    SW: tl.constexpr,
+    INS: tl.constexpr,
+    INT: tl.constexpr,
+    IND: tl.constexpr,
+    INW: tl.constexpr,
+    OS: tl.constexpr,
+    OD: tl.constexpr,
+    OUT_TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+    SILU: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_GDC: tl.constexpr = False,
+):
+    if USE_GDC:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    b = tl.program_id(0)
+    d = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK_D + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    slot = tl.load(SLOTS + b).to(tl.int64)
+    if slot < 0:
+        return
+    inter_slot = tl.load(ISLOTS + b).to(tl.int64)
+    t = tl.arange(0, T)
+    if HAS_BIAS:
+        acc = tl.broadcast_to(
+            tl.load(BIAS + d, d < D, other=0).to(tl.float32)[None, :], (T, BLOCK_D)
+        )
+    else:
+        acc = tl.full((T, BLOCK_D), 0, tl.float32)
+    h0 = tl.load(STATE + slot * SS + d * SD + 0 * SW, d < D, other=0)
+    h1 = tl.load(STATE + slot * SS + d * SD + 1 * SW, d < D, other=0)
+    h2 = tl.load(STATE + slot * SS + d * SD + 2 * SW, d < D, other=0)
+    for j in tl.static_range(4):
+        src_t = t - 3 + j
+        xi = tl.load(
+            X + b * XS + src_t[:, None] * XT + d[None, :] * XD,
+            (src_t[:, None] >= 0) & (d[None, :] < D),
+            other=0,
+        )
+        history = tl.where(
+            src_t[:, None] == -3,
+            h0[None, :],
+            tl.where(src_t[:, None] == -2, h1[None, :], h2[None, :]),
+        )
+        xi = tl.where(src_t[:, None] < 0, history, xi)
+        weight = tl.load(W + d * WD + j * WW, d < D, other=0)
+        acc += xi * weight[None, :]
+    if SILU:
+        acc = acc / (1 + tl.exp(-acc))
+    tl.store(
+        O + b * OS + t[:, None] * OUT_TOKEN_STRIDE + d[None, :] * OD,
+        acc,
+        d[None, :] < D,
+    )
+    # Deduplicated overlapping windows physically contain h1,h2,x[0:T].
+    tl.store(INTER + inter_slot * INS + d * IND + 0 * INW, h1, d < D)
+    tl.store(INTER + inter_slot * INS + d * IND + 1 * INW, h2, d < D)
+    current = tl.load(
+        X + b * XS + t[:, None] * XT + d[None, :] * XD, d[None, :] < D, other=0
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        INTER + inter_slot * INS + (t[:, None] + 2) * INT + d[None, :] * IND,
+        current,
+        d[None, :] < D,
+    )
+    if USE_GDC:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_launch_dependents()
+
+
+def clover_parallel_causal_conv(
+    x,
+    conv_state,
+    weight,
+    bias=None,
+    activation=None,
+    *,
+    conv_state_indices,
+    intermediate_conv_window,
+    intermediate_state_indices,
+    block_d=64,
+):
+    assert x.ndim == 3 and x.shape[2] in (16, 32) and weight.shape[1] == 4
+    assert intermediate_conv_window.stride(1) == intermediate_conv_window.stride(3)
+    assert activation in [None, False, True, "silu", "swish"]
+    out = torch.empty_like(x)
+    pdl = {"USE_GDC": True, "launch_pdl": True} if is_arch_support_pdl() else {}
+    _clover_parallel_causal_conv[(x.shape[0], triton.cdiv(x.shape[1], block_d))](
+        x,
+        weight,
+        bias,
+        conv_state,
+        conv_state_indices,
+        intermediate_conv_window,
+        intermediate_state_indices,
+        out,
+        x.shape[1],
+        x.shape[2],
+        *x.stride(),
+        *weight.stride(),
+        *conv_state.stride(),
+        *intermediate_conv_window.stride(),
+        *out.stride(),
+        HAS_BIAS=bias is not None,
+        SILU=activation in [True, "silu", "swish"],
+        BLOCK_D=block_d,
+        num_warps=4,

+    )

+
+
+def supports_clover_parallel_causal_conv(x, conv_state, weight, intermediate_windows):
+    return (
+        x.is_cuda
+        and x.ndim == 3
+        and x.shape[0] > 0
+        and x.shape[2] in (16, 32)
+        and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and conv_state.dtype == x.dtype
+        and weight.dtype == x.dtype
+        and intermediate_windows.dtype == x.dtype
+        and conv_state.ndim == 3
+        and conv_state.shape[1:] == (x.shape[1], 3)

+        and intermediate_windows.ndim == 4
+        and intermediate_windows.shape[0] >= x.shape[0]
+        and intermediate_windows.shape[1:] == (x.shape[2], x.shape[1], 3)
+        and intermediate_windows.stride(1) == intermediate_windows.stride(3)
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Clover block coreset selection in four kernel stages.
+
+Compute per-token top-k scores, aggregate expert mass across each block,
+select the top-p expert set, and mask router logits for Clover preview.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _float_descending_sort_key(values, valid):
+    """Pack a descending float key and ascending expert id into int64."""
+    expert_ids = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    min_i32: tl.constexpr = -2147483648
+    bits = values.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
+    sign = bits >> 31
+    key = tl.where(sign == 0, bits ^ -1, bits ^ min_i32)
+    key = tl.where(valid, key, 0x7FFFFFFF)
+    key64 = key.to(tl.int64) & 0x00000000FFFFFFFF
+    return (key64 << 32) | expert_ids.to(tl.int64)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_router_topk_scores_kernel(
+    logits_ptr,
+    generation_block_ids_ptr,
+    eligible_ptr,
+    topk_ids_ptr,
+    topk_scores_ptr,
+    logits_stride_t,
+    logits_stride_e,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_EXPERTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_E: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    expert_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_E)
+    valid = expert_offsets < NUM_EXPERTS
+    logits = tl.load(
+        logits_ptr + token_idx * logits_stride_t + expert_offsets * logits_stride_e,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    row_max = tl.max(logits, axis=0)
+    denominator = tl.sum(tl.exp(logits - row_max), axis=0)
+
+    packed = _float_descending_sort_key(logits, valid)
+    sorted_packed = tl.sort(packed, descending=False)
+    sorted_ids = (sorted_packed & 0x00000000FFFFFFFF).to(tl.int32)
+    topk_logits = tl.load(
+        logits_ptr + token_idx * logits_stride_t + sorted_ids * logits_stride_e,
+        mask=expert_offsets < TOP_K,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    topk_scores = tl.exp(topk_logits - row_max) / denominator
+    is_eligible = (tl.load(eligible_ptr + token_idx) != 0) & (
+        tl.load(generation_block_ids_ptr + token_idx) >= 0
+    )
+    topk_scores = tl.where(is_eligible, topk_scores, 0.0)
+    topk_offsets = token_idx * TOP_K + expert_offsets
+    tl.store(
+        topk_ids_ptr + topk_offsets,
+        sorted_ids,
+        mask=expert_offsets < TOP_K,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        topk_scores_ptr + topk_offsets,
+        topk_scores,
+        mask=expert_offsets < TOP_K,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_block_score_kernel(
+    topk_ids_ptr,
+    topk_scores_ptr,
+    block_scores_ptr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_EXPERTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_E: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    expert_offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_E + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_E)
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(1)
+    route_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+    route_mask = route_offsets < BLOCK_SIZE * TOP_K
+    route_base = block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE * TOP_K
+    route_ids = tl.load(
+        topk_ids_ptr + route_base + route_offsets, mask=route_mask, other=-1
+    )
+    route_scores = tl.load(
+        topk_scores_ptr + route_base + route_offsets,
+        mask=route_mask,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    matches = expert_offsets[:, None] == route_ids[None, :]
+    scores = tl.sum(tl.where(matches, route_scores[None, :], 0.0), axis=1)
+    tl.store(
+        block_scores_ptr + block_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + expert_offsets,
+        scores,
+        mask=expert_offsets < NUM_EXPERTS,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_select_coreset_kernel(
+    block_scores_ptr,
+    block_allow_ptr,
+    top_p,
+    NUM_EXPERTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_E: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    expert_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_E)
+    valid = expert_offsets < NUM_EXPERTS
+    scores = tl.load(
+        block_scores_ptr + block_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + expert_offsets,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    packed = _float_descending_sort_key(scores, valid)
+    sorted_packed = tl.sort(packed, descending=False)
+    sorted_ids = (sorted_packed & 0x00000000FFFFFFFF).to(tl.int32)
+    sorted_scores = tl.load(
+        block_scores_ptr + block_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + sorted_ids,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    total = tl.maximum(tl.sum(tl.where(valid, scores, 0.0), axis=0), 1.0e-9)
+    cumulative = tl.cumsum(sorted_scores, axis=0)
+    keep = (cumulative - sorted_scores) < top_p * total
+    keep = keep | (expert_offsets == 0)
+    tl.store(
+        block_allow_ptr + block_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + sorted_ids,
+        keep,
+        mask=valid,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_apply_coreset_kernel(
+    logits_ptr,
+    generation_block_ids_ptr,
+    eligible_ptr,
+    block_allow_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    logits_stride_t,
+    logits_stride_e,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_EXPERTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_E: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    expert_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_E)
+    valid = expert_offsets < NUM_EXPERTS
+    block_idx = token_idx // BLOCK_SIZE
+    logits = tl.load(
+        logits_ptr + token_idx * logits_stride_t + expert_offsets * logits_stride_e,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    allow = tl.load(
+        block_allow_ptr + block_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + expert_offsets,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=0,
+    )
+    is_eligible = (tl.load(eligible_ptr + token_idx) != 0) & (
+        tl.load(generation_block_ids_ptr + token_idx) >= 0
+    )
+    output = tl.where(is_eligible & ~allow, -float("inf"), logits)
+    tl.store(
+        output_ptr + token_idx * NUM_EXPERTS + expert_offsets,
+        output,
+        mask=valid,
+    )
+
+
+def supports_clover_block_coreset_triton(
+    router_logits: torch.Tensor, *, top_k: int, block_size: int
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        router_logits.is_cuda
+        and router_logits.ndim == 2
+        and router_logits.shape[1] == 256
+        and block_size in (4, 8, 16, 32)
+        and router_logits.shape[0] > 0
+        and router_logits.shape[0] % block_size == 0
+        and top_k == 8
+        and router_logits.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(router_logits.device)[0] in (9, 10)
+    )
+
+
+def _apply_clover_block_coreset_triton(
+    router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    generation_block_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    coreset_eligible: torch.Tensor,
+    top_k: int,
+    top_p: float,
+    block_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Apply the fixed Clover block coreset without PyTorch sort/scatter ops."""
+    if not supports_clover_block_coreset_triton(
+        router_logits, top_k=top_k, block_size=block_size
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "Clover coreset Triton supports CUDA, block_size in {4, 8, 16, 32}, "
+            "top_k=8, and 256 experts"
+        )
+    if not 0.0 < top_p < 1.0:
+        raise ValueError(f"Clover coreset top-p must be in (0, 1), got {top_p}")
+    num_tokens, num_experts = router_logits.shape
+    if generation_block_ids.numel() != num_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{generation_block_ids.numel()=} does not match {num_tokens=}"
+        )
+    if coreset_eligible.numel() != num_tokens:
+        raise ValueError(f"{coreset_eligible.numel()=} does not match {num_tokens=}")
+
+    batch_size = num_tokens // block_size
+    topk_ids = torch.empty(
+        (num_tokens, top_k), dtype=torch.int32, device=router_logits.device
+    )
+    topk_scores = torch.empty(
+        (num_tokens, top_k), dtype=torch.float32, device=router_logits.device
+    )
+    block_scores = torch.empty(
+        (batch_size, num_experts), dtype=torch.float32, device=router_logits.device
+    )
+    block_allow = torch.empty(
+        (batch_size, num_experts), dtype=torch.bool, device=router_logits.device
+    )
+    output = torch.empty(
+        router_logits.shape, dtype=router_logits.dtype, device=router_logits.device
+    )
+
+    # Four warps and 32-expert tiles measured faster for batch 1, block 32 on Blackwell.
+    single_block_32 = batch_size == 1 and block_size == 32
+    num_warps = 4 if single_block_32 else 8
+    score_block_e = 32 if single_block_32 else 64
+    block_r = triton.next_power_of_2(block_size * top_k)
+
+    _clover_router_topk_scores_kernel[(num_tokens,)](
+        router_logits,
+        generation_block_ids,
+        coreset_eligible,
+        topk_ids,
+        topk_scores,
+        router_logits.stride(0),
+        router_logits.stride(1),
+        TOP_K=top_k,
+        NUM_EXPERTS=num_experts,
+        BLOCK_E=256,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    _clover_block_score_kernel[(triton.cdiv(num_experts, score_block_e), batch_size)](
+        topk_ids,
+        topk_scores,
+        block_scores,
+        TOP_K=top_k,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=block_size,
+        NUM_EXPERTS=num_experts,
+        BLOCK_E=score_block_e,
+        BLOCK_R=block_r,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    _clover_select_coreset_kernel[(batch_size,)](
+        block_scores,
+        block_allow,
+        float(top_p),
+        NUM_EXPERTS=num_experts,
+        BLOCK_E=256,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    _clover_apply_coreset_kernel[(num_tokens,)](
+        router_logits,
+        generation_block_ids,
+        coreset_eligible,
+        block_allow,
+        output,
+        router_logits.stride(0),
+        router_logits.stride(1),
+        BLOCK_SIZE=block_size,
+        NUM_EXPERTS=num_experts,
+        BLOCK_E=256,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    return output
+
+
+def clover_block_coreset_triton(
+    logits: torch.Tensor, block_size: int, top_k: int, top_p: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Select experts for full Clover preview blocks; every row is eligible."""
+    return _apply_clover_block_coreset_triton(
+        logits,
+        generation_block_ids=torch.zeros(
+            logits.shape[0], device=logits.device, dtype=torch.int64
+        ),
+        coreset_eligible=torch.ones(
+            logits.shape[0], device=logits.device, dtype=torch.bool
+        ),
+        top_k=top_k,
+        top_p=top_p,
+        block_size=block_size,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Clover block penalties based only on committed response history."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _clover_penalty(
+    logits,
+    counts,
+    penalty_values,
+    row_stride,
+    VOCAB: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    FREQUENCY: tl.constexpr,
+    PRESENCE: tl.constexpr,
+    REPETITION: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    columns = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    rows = tl.arange(0, ROWS)
+    history = tl.load(counts + columns, columns < VOCAB, other=0)
+    seen = history > 0
+    offsets = rows[:, None] * row_stride + columns[None, :]
+    mask = (rows[:, None] < WIDTH) & (columns[None, :] < VOCAB)
+    values = tl.load(logits + offsets, mask, other=0)
+    if FREQUENCY:
+        frequency = tl.load(penalty_values)
+        values = values - (history * frequency)[None, :]
+    if PRESENCE:
+        presence = tl.load(penalty_values + 1)
+        values = values - tl.where(seen, presence, 0.0)[None, :]
+    if REPETITION:
+        repetition = tl.load(penalty_values + 2)
+        scale = tl.where(seen, repetition, 1.0)[None, :]
+        values = tl.where(values < 0, values * scale, values / scale)
+    tl.store(logits + offsets, values, mask)
+
+
+def clover_penalty(
+    logits,
+    counts,
+    params,
+    *,
+    frequency=True,
+    presence=True,
+    repetition=True,
+):
+    """In-place FP32 [width,vocab] penalties using committed counts only.
+
+    Params is a device FP32 vector [frequency, presence, repetition]. Additive
+    operations retain their rounding boundaries (FMA disabled), followed by
+    sign-dependent division/multiplication for repetition penalties.
+    """
+    assert logits.is_cuda and logits.dtype == torch.float32 and logits.ndim == 2
+    width, vocab = logits.shape
+    assert 1 <= width <= 128 and vocab > 0 and logits.stride(1) == 1
+    assert counts.shape == (vocab,) and counts.is_contiguous()
+    assert counts.dtype == params.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert params.shape == (3,) and params.is_contiguous()
+    assert counts.device == params.device == logits.device
+    _clover_penalty[(triton.cdiv(vocab, 256),)](
+        logits,
+        counts,
+        params,
+        logits.stride(0),
+        VOCAB=vocab,
+        WIDTH=width,
+        ROWS=triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+        FREQUENCY=frequency,
+        PRESENCE=presence,
+        REPETITION=repetition,
+        BLOCK=256,
+        num_warps=4 if width <= 16 else 8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+    )

+"""Config-time override declarations for Clover."""
+
+import logging
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import _register_for, resolving_view
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@_register_for("CloverMoeModelLM")
+def _clover_overrides(server_args: Any, hf_config: Any) -> dict:
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if (
+        cfg.speculative_algorithm is None
+        or cfg.speculative_algorithm.upper() != "CLOVER"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("CloverMoeModelLM requires --speculative-algorithm clover")
+    if cfg.dllm_algorithm is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover does not support --dllm-algorithm; use --speculative-algorithm clover"
+        )
+    if cfg.device != "cuda" or cfg.dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover preview kernels require CUDA; serving dtypes other than BF16 are unvalidated"
+        )
+    if (
+        cfg.linear_attn_backend not in ("triton", "flashinfer")
+        or cfg.linear_attn_prefill_backend not in (None, "triton", "flashinfer")
+        or cfg.linear_attn_decode_backend not in (None, "triton", "flashinfer")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover GDN backends other than Triton and FlashInfer are unvalidated"
+        )
+    if any(
+        backend not in (None, "flashinfer")
+        for backend in (
+            cfg.attention_backend,
+            cfg.prefill_attention_backend,
+            cfg.decode_attention_backend,
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover full-attention backends other than FlashInfer are unvalidated"
+        )
+    if cfg.dcp_size != 1 or cfg.attn_cp_size != 1 or cfg.attn_dp_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Clover with DCP or attention DP/CP greater than 1 is unvalidated"
+        )
+    if cfg.pp_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Clover requires pipeline parallel size 1")
+    # A2A backends can expand EP during later argument resolution.
+    if cfg.moe_a2a_backend != "none":
+        raise ValueError("Clover requires --moe-a2a-backend none")
+    if cfg.ep_size > 1 and cfg.moe_runner_backend not in ("auto", "triton"):
+        raise ValueError("Clover EP requires --moe-runner-backend triton")
+    if cfg.quantization is not None:
+        raise ValueError("Clover supports only unquantized models")
+    if cfg.disaggregation_mode != "null" or cfg.enable_hierarchical_cache:
+        raise ValueError("Clover with disaggregation or HiCache is unvalidated")
+    strategy = "no_buffer" if cfg.disable_radix_cache else "extra_buffer"
+    if cfg.mamba_radix_cache_strategy not in ("auto", strategy):
+        logger.warning(
+            "Clover requires mamba_radix_cache_strategy=%s, overriding %s.",
+            strategy,
+            cfg.mamba_radix_cache_strategy,
+        )
+    overrides = {
+        "attention_backend": "flashinfer",
+        "mamba_radix_cache_strategy": strategy,
+    }
+    if cfg.ep_size > 1:
+        overrides["moe_runner_backend"] = "triton"
+    return overrides

+    def _capture_metadata(self, bs, req_pool_indices, forward_mode, spec_info):
+        preview = forward_mode.is_dllm_extend()

+    def _replay_metadata(
+        self,
+        bs,
+        req_pool_indices,
+        forward_mode,
+        spec_info,
+        seq_lens_cpu,
+        num_padding=None,
+        in_capture=False,
+        mamba_track_indices=None,

+        preview = forward_mode.is_dllm_extend()

+    def forward_extend(self, layer, forward_batch, mixed_qkv, a, b, **kwargs):

+            forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            and spec is not None
+            and spec.spec_input_type == SpecInputType.CLOVER_VERIFY

+                self.kernel_dispatcher.verify_kernel,

+            and mixed_qkv.is_cuda

+            intermediate_conv_window=windows,
+            intermediate_state_indices=snapshot_slots,

+        if isinstance(self.kernel_dispatcher.verify_kernel, TritonGDNKernel):

+                layer.num_k_heads,
+                layer.num_v_heads,
+                layer.head_q_dim,
+                layer.head_k_dim,
+                layer.head_v_dim,
+            )

+            dt_bias=layer.dt_bias,
+            q=query,
+            k=key,
+            v=value,
+            a=a,
+            b=b,

+            query_start_loc=self.forward_metadata.query_start_loc,
+            intermediate_states_buffer=snapshots,
+            intermediate_state_indices=snapshot_slots,
+            cache_steps=width,
+            retrieve_parent_token=None,
+            stable_rows=pp_spec_stable_rows_enabled(),
+        )

+def block_coreset(logits, block_size, top_k, top_p):
+    if 0.0 < top_p < 1.0 and supports_clover_block_coreset_triton(
+        logits, top_k=top_k, block_size=block_size
+    ):
+        return clover_block_coreset_triton(logits, block_size, top_k, top_p)
+    return _block_coreset_reference(logits, block_size, top_k, top_p)
+
+
+def _block_coreset_reference(logits, block_size, top_k, top_p):
+    scores = logits.view(-1, block_size, logits.shape[-1]).float()
+    ids = scores.argsort(dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)[..., :top_k]
+    mass = scores.softmax(-1).gather(-1, ids)
+    totals = torch.zeros_like(scores[:, 0])
+    totals.scatter_add_(1, ids.flatten(1), mass.flatten(1))
+    probs = totals / totals.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-9)
+    order = probs.argsort(dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
+    ordered = probs.gather(-1, order)
+    keep = ordered.cumsum(-1) - ordered < top_p
+    allowed = torch.zeros_like(keep).scatter(1, order, keep)
+    return (
+        logits.view_as(scores)
+        .masked_fill(~allowed[:, None], -float("inf"))
+        .view_as(logits)
+    )
+

+# Adapted from qwen3_5.py::_qwen3_5_stage_facts.

+class CloverSparseMoeBlock(Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock):
+    def __init__(self, *, config, **kwargs):

+        self.clover_coreset = config.moe_block_coreset_enabled
+        self.clover_top_k = config.num_experts_per_tok
+        self.clover_top_p = config.moe_block_coreset_top_p
+
+    @property

+        # Clover's layer boundaries do not install a deferred-finalize consumer.

+
+    # The coreset restricts routed experts only, before top-k, and only in preview.
+    def _forward_router_experts(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
+    ):
+        router_logits, _ = self.gate(hidden_states)
+        if (
+            self.clover_coreset
+            and forward_batch is not None
+            and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_dllm_extend()
+        ):
+            router_logits = block_coreset(
+                router_logits,
+                hidden_states.shape[0] // forward_batch.batch_size,
+                self.clover_top_k,
+                self.clover_top_p,
+            )
+        topk_output = self.topk(hidden_states, router_logits)
+        if self.enable_shared_expert_fusion:
+            if not TopKOutputChecker.format_is_standard(topk_output):
+                raise RuntimeError("Clover shared-expert fusion requires standard TopK")
+            topk_output = self._append_shared_to_topk_output(topk_output, hidden_states)
+        return self.experts(hidden_states, topk_output)
+
+    def forward_normal_dual_stream(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        use_fused_gate: bool = False,
+        forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.alt_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
+        shared_output = (
+            self._forward_shared_experts(
+                hidden_states.clone(), apply_gate=not use_fused_gate
+            )
+            if self.shared_expert is not None
+            else None
+        )
+
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.alt_stream):
+            router_output = self._forward_router_experts(
+                hidden_states, forward_batch=forward_batch
+            )
+        current_stream.wait_stream(self.alt_stream)
+
+        return router_output, shared_output
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        forward_batch: Optional[ForwardBatch] = None,
+        defer_finalize: bool = False,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if defer_finalize:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clover does not use deferred MoE finalization")
+        num_tokens, hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.view(-1, hidden_dim)
+
+        use_fused_gate = self.shared_expert_gate is not None
+        if hidden_states.shape[0] == 0:
+            shared_output = None
+            topk_output = self.topk.empty_topk_output(hidden_states.device)
+            final_hidden_states = self.experts(hidden_states, topk_output)
+        elif (
+            self.alt_stream is not None
+            and get_is_capture_mode()
+            and not torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+        ):
+            final_hidden_states, shared_output = self.forward_normal_dual_stream(
+                hidden_states,
+                use_fused_gate=use_fused_gate,
+                forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            )
+        else:
+            shared_output = self._forward_shared_experts(
+                hidden_states, apply_gate=not use_fused_gate
+            )
+            final_hidden_states = self._forward_router_experts(
+                hidden_states, forward_batch=forward_batch
+            )
+
+        if shared_output is not None:
+            if use_fused_gate:
+                fused_gate_sigmoid_mul_add(
+                    hidden_states,
+                    self.shared_expert_gate.weight.squeeze(),
+                    shared_output,
+                    final_hidden_states,
+                )
+            else:
+                final_hidden_states += shared_output
+        if self.reduce_results:
+            final_hidden_states = reduce_moe_output(final_hidden_states)
+        return final_hidden_states.view(num_tokens, hidden_dim)

+        backend = get_attn_backend().linear_attn_backend

+        key = key.view(1, seq_len, self.num_k_heads, self.head_k_dim)
+        value = value.view(1, seq_len, self.num_v_heads, self.head_v_dim)
+        if not supports_clover_local_memory_triton(

+            ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+            ("in_proj_qkvz", "in_proj_qkv", (0, 1, 2)),

+"""Launch and request constraints for single-model Clover speculation."""

+import json
+import logging
+import math

+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_override_base import model_config_of
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import declare_resolution, resolving_view
+from sglang.srt.speculative.clover_penalty import validate_clover_penalties
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+

+def configure_clover(server_args):
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    model = model_config_of(server_args)
+    if model.hf_config.architectures != ["CloverMoeModelLM"]:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER speculative decoding requires CloverMoeModelLM")
+    if cfg.dllm_algorithm is not None:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER cannot be combined with --dllm-algorithm")
+    if cfg.speculative_draft_model_path is not None:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER shares the target model; do not specify a draft model")
+    if cfg.speculative_adaptive:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER does not support adaptive speculation")
+    if cfg.enable_lora or cfg.enable_two_batch_overlap or cfg.enable_torch_compile:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "CLOVER does not support LoRA, two-batch overlap or torch.compile"
+        )
+    if cfg.enable_watermark:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER does not support watermarking")
+    if cfg.linear_attn_verify_backend not in (None, "triton", "flashinfer"):
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER requires Triton or FlashInfer linear-attention verify")
+    if (
+        cfg.enable_linear_replayssm
+        or cfg.enable_linear_replayssm_spec
+        or cfg.enable_mis
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "CLOVER preview requires materialized recurrent state; ReplaySSM and MIS are unsupported"
+        )
+    if cfg.enable_return_hidden_states or cfg.enable_return_routed_experts:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "CLOVER does not support returning hidden states or routed experts"
+        )
+    checkpoint_width = model.hf_config.block_size
+    width = (
+        checkpoint_width
+        if cfg.speculative_num_draft_tokens is None
+        else cfg.speculative_num_draft_tokens
+    )
+    if width < 2 or checkpoint_width % width:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "CLOVER verify width must be >= 2 and divide checkpoint block_size"
+        )
+    if cfg.speculative_clover_accept_rule not in ("threshold", "exact"):
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER accept rule must be threshold or exact")
+    ratio = cfg.speculative_clover_accept_ratio
+    delta = cfg.speculative_clover_accept_delta
+    if not 0 <= ratio <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER accept ratio must be finite and in [0, 1]")
+    if not math.isfinite(delta) or delta < 0:
+        raise ValueError("CLOVER accept delta must be finite and non-negative")
+    for name in ("speculative_num_steps", "speculative_eagle_topk"):
+        value = getattr(cfg, name)
+        if value is not None and int(value) != 1:
+            logger.warning(
+                "CLOVER only supports %s == 1, overriding %s to 1.", name, value
+            )
+    if cfg.enable_mixed_chunk:
+        logger.warning("CLOVER does not support mixed chunked prefill, disabling it.")
+    preferred = cfg.preferred_sampling_params or {}
+    if isinstance(preferred, str):
+        preferred = json.loads(preferred)
+    declare_resolution(
+        server_args,
+        "CLOVER",
+        preferred_sampling_params={
+            "presence_penalty": 0.9,
+            "repetition_penalty": 1.05,
+            **preferred,
+        },
+        speculative_num_draft_tokens=width,
+        speculative_num_steps=1,
+        speculative_eagle_topk=1,
+        disable_overlap_schedule=True,
+        enable_mixed_chunk=False,
+    )
+

+def validate_clover_request(req):
+    sp = req.sampling_params
+    unsupported = []
+    for name, default in (("min_p", 0.0),):
+        if getattr(sp, name) != default:
+            unsupported.append(name)
+    for name in ("json_schema", "regex", "ebnf", "structural_tag", "logit_bias"):
+        if getattr(sp, name):
+            unsupported.append(name)
+    for name in (
+        "return_logprob",
+        "return_sampling_mask",
+        "custom_logit_processor",
+        "input_embeds",
+        "positional_embed_overrides",
+        "return_hidden_states",

+        self.spec_input_type = SpecInputType.CLOVER_DRAFT
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_tokens(cls, bonus_tokens, new_seq_lens):
+        device = bonus_tokens.device
+        bs = bonus_tokens.numel()
+        return cls(
+            topk_p=torch.empty((bs, 0), device=device),
+            topk_index=torch.empty((bs, 0), device=device, dtype=torch.int64),

+
+@dataclass
+class CloverPreviewInput(SpecInput):
+    """Fixed-width noncausal draft forward; KV lengths already include the block.
+
+    Separate from CloverDraftInput, which carries scheduler state between rounds.
+    Only scalar shape metadata is retained, so graph replay rebuilds indices from
+    the current batch's KV plan, including padded request slots.
+    """
+
+    num_tokens_per_req: int
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def draft_token_num(self):
+        return self.num_tokens_per_req
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        super().__init__(SpecInputType.CLOVER_DRAFT)
+        if self.num_tokens_per_req <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Clover preview width must be positive")
+        self.num_tokens_for_logprob_per_req = self.num_tokens_per_req
+
+    def generate_attn_arg_prefill(
+        self,
+        *,
+        req_pool_indices,
+        paged_kernel_lens,
+        paged_kernel_lens_sum,
+        translator,
+        plan,
+        kind=IdSpaceKind.FULL,
+    ):
+        bs = req_pool_indices.numel()
+        device = req_pool_indices.device
+        width = self.num_tokens_per_req
+        qo_indptr = torch.arange(
+            0, (bs + 1) * width, width, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        kv_indptr = torch.zeros(bs + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        kv_indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(paged_kernel_lens, dim=0)
+        kv_indices = torch.empty(
+            paged_kernel_lens_sum + 256, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        translator.pack_read_stream(
+            plan,
+            req_pool_indices=req_pool_indices,
+            seq_lens=paged_kernel_lens,
+            indptr=kv_indptr,
+            out=kv_indices,
+            kind=kind,
+        )
+        return kv_indices, kv_indptr, qo_indptr, None
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+import math
+from collections import Counter
+
+import torch
+
+
+class CloverPenaltyState:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._histories = {}
+        self._committed = {}
+        self._parameters = {}
+
+    def retain(self, reqs):
+        active = {id(req) for req in reqs}
+        self._histories = {
+            key: value for key, value in self._histories.items() if key in active
+        }
+        self._committed = {
+            key: value for key, value in self._committed.items() if key in active
+        }
+        self._parameters = {
+            key: value for key, value in self._parameters.items() if key in active
+        }
+
+    def parameters(self, req, device):
+        sp = req.sampling_params
+        values = (sp.frequency_penalty, sp.presence_penalty, sp.repetition_penalty)
+        previous = self._parameters.get(id(req))
+        if (
+            previous is None
+            or previous[0] is not req
+            or previous[1] != values
+            or previous[2].device != device
+        ):
+            params = torch.tensor(
+                values, dtype=torch.float32, pin_memory=device.type == "cuda"
+            ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
+            self._parameters[id(req)] = (req, values, params)
+            return params
+        return previous[2]
+
+    def history(self, req, vocab_size):
+        previous = self._histories.get(id(req))
+        output = req.output_ids
+        if (
+            previous is None
+            or previous[0] is not req
+            or previous[1] is not output
+            or previous[2] > len(output)
+        ):
+            old_len, counts = 0, Counter()
+        else:
+            old_len, counts = previous[2:]
+        counts.update(t for t in output[old_len:] if 0 <= t < vocab_size)
+        self._histories[id(req)] = (req, output, len(output), counts)
+        return counts
+
+    def committed_counts(self, req, vocab_size, device):
+        previous = self._committed.get(id(req))
+        output = req.output_ids
+        if (
+            previous is None
+            or previous[0] is not req
+            or previous[1] is not output
+            or previous[2] > len(output)
+            or previous[3].numel() != vocab_size
+            or previous[3].device != device
+        ):
+            old_len = 0
+            counts = torch.zeros(vocab_size, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+        else:
+            old_len, counts = previous[2:]
+        if old_len < len(output):
+            delta = [t for t in output[old_len:] if 0 <= t < vocab_size]
+            if delta:
+                # Fresh pinned storage outlives the async copy, a reused one races it.
+                ids = torch.tensor(
+                    delta, dtype=torch.long, pin_memory=device.type == "cuda"
+                ).to(device, non_blocking=True)
+                counts.scatter_add_(0, ids, torch.ones_like(ids, dtype=counts.dtype))
+        self._committed[id(req)] = (req, output, len(output), counts)
+        return counts
+
+
+def validate_clover_penalties(req):
+    sp = req.sampling_params
+    custom = {
+        "dllm_length_penalty": 10.0,
+        "dllm_think_end_bias": 10.0,
+        "dllm_think_end_start": 4096,
+        **(sp.custom_params or {}),
+    }
+    for key in ("dllm_length_penalty", "dllm_think_end_bias"):
+        value = custom.get(key, 0.0)
+        if type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
+            return f"CLOVER custom_params.{key} must be finite and non-negative"
+    for key, default, minimum in (
+        ("dllm_length_penalty_start", 8192, 0),
+        ("dllm_length_penalty_window", 8192, 1),
+        ("dllm_think_end_start", 4096, 0),
+        ("dllm_think_end_window", 4096, 1),
+    ):
+        value = custom.get(key, default)
+        if type(value) is not int or value < minimum:
+            return f"CLOVER custom_params.{key} must be an integer >= {minimum}"
+    token = custom.get("dllm_think_end_token_id")
+    tokenizer = req.tokenizer
+    if custom.get("dllm_think_end_bias", 0) > 0 and token is None:
+        encoded = (
+            tokenizer.encode("</think>", add_special_tokens=False)
+            if tokenizer is not None
+            else []
+        )
+        if len(encoded) != 1 or encoded[0] == getattr(tokenizer, "unk_token_id", None):
+            return "CLOVER think-end bias requires a single dllm_think_end_token_id"
+        token = encoded[0]
+    if token is not None:
+        if (
+            type(token) is not int
+            or token < 0
+            or (tokenizer is not None and token >= len(tokenizer))
+        ):
+            return "CLOVER dllm_think_end_token_id must be a valid vocabulary ID"
+        custom["dllm_think_end_token_id"] = token
+    sp.custom_params = custom
+    return None
+
+
+def _stop_tokens(req, vocab_size):
+    tokenizer = req.tokenizer
+    stops = set(req.sampling_params.stop_token_ids or ())
+    stops.update(req.eos_token_ids or ())
+    stops.update(getattr(tokenizer, "additional_stop_token_ids", None) or ())
+    stops.add(getattr(tokenizer, "eos_token_id", None))
+    return sorted(t for t in stops if t is not None and 0 <= t < vocab_size)
+
+
+def apply_clover_penalties(logits, reqs, visible_tokens, *, preview=False, state=None):
+    """Modify [batch, width, vocab] logits in place; explicitly disabled penalties are a no-op.
+
+    Row zero of the preview is an already committed pending token; row one
+    predicts the next output. Verify row zero predicts that same next output.
+    Length ramps use actual output lengths plus these aligned offsets. Custom
+    biases apply to speculative rounds; initial prefill sampling retains the
+    native penalties.
+    """
+    _, width, vocab_size = logits.shape
+    if state is None:
+        state = CloverPenaltyState()
+    state.retain(reqs)
+    for row, req in enumerate(reqs):
+        sp = req.sampling_params
+        custom = sp.custom_params or {}
+        length_bias = custom.get("dllm_length_penalty", 0.0)
+        think_bias = custom.get("dllm_think_end_bias", 0.0)
+        if not (
+            sp.frequency_penalty
+            or sp.presence_penalty
+            or sp.repetition_penalty != 1
+            or sp.min_new_tokens
+            or length_bias
+            or think_bias
+        ):
+            continue
+        scores = logits[row]
+        history = state.history(req, vocab_size)
+        if sp.frequency_penalty or sp.presence_penalty or sp.repetition_penalty != 1:
+            counts = state.committed_counts(req, vocab_size, logits.device)
+            if (
+                scores.is_cuda
+                and scores.dtype == torch.float32
+                and scores.stride(1) == 1
+                and width <= 128
+            ):
+                from sglang.kernels.ops.sampling.clover_penalty import clover_penalty
+
+                clover_penalty(
+                    scores,
+                    counts,
+                    state.parameters(req, logits.device),
+                    frequency=bool(sp.frequency_penalty),
+                    presence=bool(sp.presence_penalty),
+                    repetition=sp.repetition_penalty != 1,
+                )
+            else:
+                seen = counts > 0
+                if sp.frequency_penalty:
+                    scores.sub_(counts * sp.frequency_penalty)
+                if sp.presence_penalty:
+                    scores.sub_(seen.to(scores.dtype) * sp.presence_penalty)
+                if sp.repetition_penalty != 1:
+                    scale = torch.where(seen, sp.repetition_penalty, 1.0)
+                    from sglang.srt.sampling.penaltylib.repetition_penalty import (
+                        apply_scaling_penalties,
+                    )
+
+                    apply_scaling_penalties(scores, scale[None, :])
+
+        # One-based response positions of the token predicted by each row.
+        first_position = len(req.output_ids) + (0 if preview else 1)
+        positions = range(first_position, first_position + width)
+        stops = _stop_tokens(req, vocab_size)
+        if (
+            length_bias
+            and stops
+            and not sp.ignore_eos
+            and first_position + width - 1
+            > custom.get("dllm_length_penalty_start", 8192)
+        ):
+            start = custom.get("dllm_length_penalty_start", 8192)
+            window = custom.get("dllm_length_penalty_window", 8192)
+            ramp = torch.tensor(
+                [length_bias * min(max((p - start) / window, 0), 1) for p in positions],
+                device=logits.device,
+                dtype=logits.dtype,
+            )
+            scores[:, stops] += ramp[:, None]
+        token = custom.get("dllm_think_end_token_id")
+        if think_bias and token is not None and token not in history:
+            start = custom.get("dllm_think_end_start", 4096)
+            window = custom.get("dllm_think_end_window", 4096)
+            # Only the first eligible position gets a bias. During verification
+            # an uncommitted draft </think> must not disable its own bias.
+            index = max(int(preview), start + 1 - first_position)
+            if index < width:
+                bias = think_bias * min((first_position + index - start) / window, 1)
+                if preview:
+                    bias = bias * ~(visible_tokens[row] == token).any()
+                scores[index, token] += bias
+        # Hard minimum wins over either positive bias. The EOS itself does not
+        # count towards the required number of preceding response tokens.
+        if sp.min_new_tokens and stops:
+            num_blocked = min(width, max(0, sp.min_new_tokens - first_position + 1))
+            scores[:num_blocked, stops] = -float("inf")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Tensor-only acceptance for Clover's linear candidate chain."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def clover_correct_drafts(
+    logits, candidates, accept_ratio=0.9, accept_delta=0.6, accept_rule="threshold"
+):
+    """Return counts excluding bonus; logits[j] verifies candidates[j + 1].
+
+    Exact matches the verify argmax; threshold uses raw target probabilities.
+    Both are independent of temperature/top-k/top-p used for the boundary token.
+    """
+    if accept_rule == "exact":
+        matches = candidates[:, 1:] == logits[:, :-1].argmax(dim=-1)
+        return matches.to(torch.int32).cumprod(dim=-1).sum(-1).to(torch.int32)
+    if accept_rule != "threshold":
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown Clover accept rule: {accept_rule}")
+    probabilities = torch.softmax(logits[:, :-1].float(), dim=-1)
+    proposal_probs = probabilities.gather(-1, candidates[:, 1:, None]).squeeze(-1)
+    entropy = -(probabilities * probabilities.clamp_min(1e-12).log()).sum(-1)
+    thresholds = torch.minimum(
+        torch.full_like(entropy, accept_ratio), accept_delta * torch.exp(-entropy)
+    )
+    # A zero threshold must still reject candidates a hard penalty blocked.
+    matches = (proposal_probs >= thresholds) & (proposal_probs > 0)
+    return matches.to(torch.int32).cumprod(dim=-1).sum(-1).to(torch.int32)
+
+
+def clover_accept_tokens(candidates, num_correct_drafts, bonus_tokens):
+    """Padded output rows: correct drafts followed by the newly sampled bonus."""
+    width = candidates.shape[1]
+    offsets = torch.arange(width, device=candidates.device)[None, :]
+    shifted = torch.cat((candidates[:, 1:], bonus_tokens[:, None]), dim=1)
+    return torch.where(
+        offsets < num_correct_drafts[:, None], shifted, bonus_tokens[:, None]
+    )
